name: j7_priors
description: Per-tier aligned-WR priors derived from the bonereaper 30-day spot-vs-book audit (n=306,966 BTC 5-min trades). Used by MarketMakerStrategy (Phase S) for per-ladder-level p_win estimation and by SpotAwareStrategyV2_1 (J.7 sketch, design/bonereaper_blended_priors.md) for Bayesian-blended priors.

freshness_check.verdict: Direct WR stable within 0.8pp of 30d baseline (50.93% vs 51.7%); priors table considered current. Session 2 backtest WILL re-derive an aligned table on the 2026-05-19 data via scripts/research/bonereaper_spot_vs_book.py before final sizing.

notes: Aligned = spot-Δ aligned with bet side (UP+Δ>0 or DOWN+Δ<0). Contrarian = opposed. Flat = |Δ_bps|<5.

MarketMakerStrategy (Phase S) does NOT condition on alignment at order-place time — it ladders both sides. Use aligned_wr as p_win prior for the LADDER LEVEL's tier; the alignment of any fill is incidental to the ladder design.

Bonereaper's $/trade is highest in the <15% tier (+$8.83 aligned, +$0.50 contrarian) because favored-side losing fills there cost only the fill price ($0.05-$0.15). MMB must size CONSERVATIVELY here: low-tier wins are huge but losing-side fills accumulate fast at $20-$50/level.
85-100% tier is bonereaper's volume sink ($5.46M of $12.13M notional, 45% of book). MMB at $3k bankroll cannot replicate the depth in this tier; expect lower per-level sizes there.

Session 2's backtest harness will produce a refreshed table keyed on (tier, abs_delta_bucket, side) for finer-grained sizing. This file is the bootstrap table — bonereaper-blended priors §3.1 defines the upgrade path.
